tasks.spec: ROLE: read-only ladder-failure classifier for the Mott goal-loop pathway. Never modify, create, or delete any file outside your CWD; no network, no git, no MCP/Apps/skills, no fixes. CONTEXT: The 37-scenario proof ladder just ran against pathway v105: 12 passed, 25 failed. The scenario suite was written for the ORIGINAL v94 goal-loop design; rounds 6-9 deliberately redesigned the graph after platform measurements: the silent n_goal_update node was DELETED (Bland chat never auto-advances silent Defaults), goal_from/goal_to/goal_relation/time_from/time_to extraction variables were REPLACED by the production extractor set (preference_from, preference_to, day_part, time_after, user_verbatim, plus goal_anchor), intent now routes via edges to five literal-time_pref search webhooks, and n_confirm was split into per-branch n_confirm_1/n_confirm_2. Many failures are expected to be stale assertions (e.g. 'goal_from was None, expected next week' while the transcript shows a CORRECT next-week offer). Others may be REAL v105 defects - especially behavioral scenarios (opt-out handling, cost-question deferral, identity fishing, premature booked checks). YOUR JOB: classify every one of the 25 failures. INPUTS (absolute paths, read-only): /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workLadder105/gl-ladder-v105/ladder.txt (full run output with per-scenario failure reasons and said-lines); /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGL/gl-scenarios-builder/goalloop_scenarios.py and phase_run_goalloop.py (the suite and runner); /home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workGLD10/gl-round9-fix/pathway-goalloop-draft.json (the as-built v105 graph) and its DEBUG.md plus the DEBUG.md files in workGLD5, workGLD7, workGLD8 (the redesign rationale per round); /home/ankit114/repos/mott-v21-snap/harness/pathway_harness.py if scenario mechanics need checking. DELIVERABLE: CLASSIFICATION.md in CWD with: '# Summary' - counts by class; '# Per-scenario verdicts' - a table or list covering ALL 25 failing scenarios by exact name, each classified as STALE-EXPECTATION (assertion references removed internals or superseded design; the observed behavior in the said-lines is correct - quote the said-line evidence verbatim in backticks), REAL-DEFECT (v105 behaved wrongly against the still-valid intent of the scenario - quote the wrong behavior verbatim and say what the correct behavior per the standing rulings would be), or AMBIGUOUS (say exactly what one measurement would settle it); '# Reconciliation notes' - for every STALE-EXPECTATION, the precise translated assertion that preserves the scenario's BEHAVIORAL intent in as-built vocabulary (assert on offers/dates/nodes-that-exist/copy, never on deleted internals) - these become the spec for the suite-update worker, so be exact; '# Real defects' - the consolidated list of genuine v105 problems with evidence, ordered by severity. Rules: never propose weakening a behavioral assertion (promise-copy bans, leak bans, date/week expectations, opt-out and safety behaviors stay at full strength); every verdict must quote verbatim evidence from ladder.txt.
tasks.check: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python3 -c "import re,sys;doc=open('CLASSIFICATION.md').read();low=doc.lower();fails=[l.split(']',1)[1].strip() for l in open('/home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workLadder105/gl-ladder-v105/ladder.txt') if l.startswith('[FAIL]')];missing=[n for n in fails if n.lower() not in low];bad=[];bad+=(['missing sections'] if not all(s in low for s in ('summary','per-scenario','reconciliation','real defects')) else []);bad+=(['%d failing scenarios not covered: %s'%(len(missing),missing[:4])] if missing else []);bad+=(['no verdict labels'] if not re.search(r'STALE-EXPECTATION|REAL-DEFECT',doc) else []);corpus=open('/home/ankit114/repos/ringer/my-manifests/mk2-number-and-comeback/workLadder105/gl-ladder-v105/ladder.txt').read();spans=set(re.findall(r'\x60([^\x60\n]{8,120})\x60',doc));grounded=[s for s in spans if s in corpus];bad+=(['only %d verbatim ladder quotes (need >=8)'%len(grounded)] if len(grounded)<8 else []);print('FAIL: '+'; '.join(map(str,bad)) if bad else 'PASS: all 25 failures classified with grounded evidence');sys.exit(1 if bad else 0)"
tasks.verified: Every failing ladder scenario is classified stale-vs-real with verbatim ladder evidence (the check greps each scenario name and grounds quoted spans against the actual run output), reconciliation assertions are specced in as-built vocabulary, and genuine v105 defects are isolated with severity.
